name: DBT BioCARe Programme for Women Researchers
funder: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India
amount: Consolidated research grant (recurring and non-recurring) plus fellowship; amounts per DBT terms and conditions
other_rules: Indian women nationals residing in India
unemployed or not in a regular position
first extramural grant as PI (no earlier government grant as PI)
not enrolled in higher studies or holding another fellowship
Category I: PhD in biotech/life sciences/allied or MD/MDS/MVSc
Category II: MTech biotech/MPharm or equivalent
notes: 2026-27 call closed 23 Sep 2026 (the notice says 30 days from 25 Aug). Contact biocare.dbt@rcb.res.in. Renamed DBT schemes may apply; check dbt.gov.in for amounts.
